#!/bin/bash
# Restart a service on the deploy host and announce the release.

set -euo pipefail

DRY_RUN=0
ARGS=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    *) ARGS+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done

SERVICE=${ARGS[0]:-}
VERSION=${ARGS[1]:-}
NOTE=${ARGS[2]:-}

if [[ -z "$SERVICE" || -z "$VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "usage: $0 SERVICE VERSION [NOTE] [--dry-run]" >&2
  exit 1
fi

REMOTE_HOST=deploy@deploy.example.internal
SLACK_URL="$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"

. etc/services.conf

# Per-service override, for example CONFIG_web=/etc/web/deploy.conf
# Indirect expansion instead of eval so SERVICE can't run arbitrary code.
CONFIG_VAR="CONFIG_${SERVICE}"
CONFIG="${!CONFIG_VAR:-}"

echo "deploying $SERVICE $VERSION with $CONFIG"

# %q shell-quotes each piece so SERVICE/VERSION can't break out of the remote command.
REMOTE_CMD=$(printf 'sudo systemctl restart %q && /usr/local/bin/deploy %q %q' "$SERVICE" "$SERVICE" "$VERSION")

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]]; then
  echo "[dry-run] would run: ssh $REMOTE_HOST $REMOTE_CMD"
else
  ssh "$REMOTE_HOST" "$REMOTE_CMD"
fi

TEXT="Deployed $SERVICE $VERSION by $USER"
if [[ -n "$NOTE" ]]; then
  TEXT="$TEXT: $NOTE"
fi

# jq builds a properly escaped JSON string regardless of what NOTE contains.
PAYLOAD=$(jq -n --arg text "$TEXT" '{text: $text}')

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]]; then
  echo "[dry-run] would POST to Slack ($SLACK_URL): $PAYLOAD"
else
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' -d "$PAYLOAD" "$SLACK_URL"
fi

# deploy-tools

Deployment helpers for the internal services.

`bin/notify-deploy.sh SERVICE VERSION [NOTE] [--dry-run]` restarts the service on the deploy
host and posts a message to the release channel. The webhook URL comes from
`SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` in the environment; per-service settings live in `etc/services.conf`.

- `NOTE` is an optional release note, included in the Slack message.
- `--dry-run` prints the ssh command and Slack payload that would be sent, without
  restarting the service or posting to Slack. It can appear anywhere in the argument list.

Example:

```
bin/notify-deploy.sh web 1.4.0 "fixes checkout redirect loop" --dry-run
```
